raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "1.10.19" %}
{% set sha256 = "f2a62b234e0b12cac6f999f44e67fbbee52f0714c3bd4866bcc32bf8b8f09ea9" %}
{% set build_number = 1 %}
{% set deno_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export\sDENO=v(\S+)') %}
{% set deno_dom_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export DENO_DOM=v([^-]+)') %}
{% set pandoc_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export PANDOC=(\S+)') %}
{% set dartsass_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export DARTSASS=(\S+)') %}
{% set esbuild_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export ESBUILD=(\S+)') %}
{% set typst_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export TYPST=(\S+)') %}
{% set typst_gather_version = load_file_regex(load_file='configuration', regex_pattern='export TYPST_GATHER=(\S+)') %}

package:
  name: quarto
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/quarto-dev/quarto-cli/releases/download/v{{ version }}/quarto-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: {{ sha256 }}
  patches:
    - patches/0001-win-conda-path-overrides.patch  # [win]

build:
  number: {{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    # The C toolchain is not used to compile anything, but its presence is what
    # puts conda-build in dual-prefix mode, so the build-time tools below land
    # in $BUILD_PREFIX. build.sh/bld.bat rely on that to find them.
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - deno      {{ deno_version.group(1) if deno_version else "" }}
    - deno-dom  {{ deno_dom_version.group(1) if deno_dom_version else "" }}
    # bld.bat wires QUARTO_DART_SASS to a sass.exe in BUILD_PREFIX at build
    # time, so dart-sass has to be a build dependency too.
    - dart-sass {{ "==" ~ dartsass_version.group(1) if dartsass_version else "" }}
    - esbuild {{ "==" ~ esbuild_version.group(1) if esbuild_version else "" }}
    - pandoc {{ "==" ~ pandoc_version.group(1) if pandoc_version else "" }}
    - typst {{ "==" ~ typst_version.group(1) if typst_version else "" }}
    # prepare-dist configures typst-gather by looking it up on PATH when
    # QUARTO_VENDOR_BINARIES=false, so it has to be present at build time too.
    - typst-gather {{ ">=" ~ typst_gather_version.group(1) ~ ",<0.3" if typst_gather_version else "" }}
    - nodejs
  host:
    # deno and deno-dom are duplicated from build: so pin_compatible() in run:
    # can resolve their versions. conda-build only looks at host for that.
    - deno      {{ deno_version.group(1) if deno_version else "" }}
    - deno-dom  {{ deno_dom_version.group(1) if deno_dom_version else "" }}
  run:
    # Deno, deno-dom and pandoc have proven to be fickle
    #    regarding Quarto's source code. The pinning here
    #    is not so much that there are binary compatibility
    #    issues, but just that these dependencies are only
    #    known to work in a pretty narrow range.
    - {{ pin_compatible("deno", max_pin="x.x.x") }}
    # we vendor deno-dom JS dependencies, so it is important
    #  that the version at runtime matches the one at build time
    - {{ pin_compatible("deno-dom", max_pin="x.x.x") }}
    - pandoc {{ "==" ~ pandoc_version.group(1) if pandoc_version else "" }}
    - typst {{ "==" ~ typst_version.group(1) if typst_version else "" }}
    # Since 1.10 typst-gather is a separate upstream project rather than a
    # crate inside the Quarto tree. Quarto shells out to it to work out which
    # Typst packages a document needs, and falls back to staging all of them
    # (with a warning on every render) when it is missing.
    # The pin is a range, not the usual ==, because Quarto 1.10.x's
    # configuration freezes TYPST_GATHER at 0.2.3 while the conda package is
    # 0.2.4 (license-only release, see conda-forge/staged-recipes#35412).
    # The <0.3 upper bound is hand-maintained and should fail loudly the day
    # Quarto moves to typst-gather 0.3.x.
    - typst-gather {{ ">=" ~ typst_gather_version.group(1) ~ ",<0.3" if typst_gather_version else "" }}
    # Quarto's version check strictly compares dart-sass against the DARTSASS
    # version in its configuration file and warns on every `quarto check`
    # otherwise. esbuild is pinned from the same file for consistency.
    - dart-sass {{ "==" ~ dartsass_version.group(1) if dartsass_version else "" }}
    - esbuild {{ "==" ~ esbuild_version.group(1) if esbuild_version else "" }}

test:
  commands:
    - quarto check
    - "[ \"$(quarto --version)\" = \"{{ version }}\" ] || (echo \"Version set incorrectly\" && exit 1)"  # [unix]
    # it would be nice to do a version check on windows too, but I don't have a win machine and don't want to debug on CI
    - quarto render hello.qmd --to html
    - test -e "${QUARTO_SHARE_PATH}/preview/quarto-preview.js"  # [unix]
    # QUARTO_TYPST_GATHER is wired by the activate script; a dangling path
    # here means the wiring is broken even if every render test passes.
    - test -f "${QUARTO_TYPST_GATHER}"  # [unix]
    - if not exist "%QUARTO_TYPST_GATHER%" exit 1  # [win]
    # quarto runs typst-gather analyze on every typst render, but a failure
    # only warns and falls back to staging all packages, exiting 0. So the
    # render alone stays green on a broken typst-gather; grep stderr for the
    # fallback warning.
    - quarto render hello-typst.qmd --to typst 2> typst-render.log
    # `! grep -q` would not work here: bash exempts negated commands from
    # errexit, so a match would not fail the test run. Exit explicitly.
    - "if grep -q 'typst-gather analyze failed' typst-render.log; then cat typst-render.log; exit 1; fi"  # [unix]
    - "findstr /C:\"typst-gather analyze failed\" typst-render.log && exit 1 || exit 0"  # [win]
  files:
    - hello.qmd
    - hello-typst.qmd
  requires:
    - jupyter
    - python >=3
    - r-base >=4

about:
  home: https://quarto.org/
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - COPYRIGHT
    - COPYING.md
  summary: An open-source scientific and technical publishing system built on Pandoc

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - SaravananSathyanandhaQC
    - cderv
    - cscheid
    - dragonstyle
    - mfisher87
    - msarahan
